combo1.title: Going Second: Venom Serpent and Lamia Become Four Heavenly Dragons, Then Vaskii Eats Their Board
combo1.description: Going second into two face-up monsters. Starting hand: Venom Serpent, Reptilianne Lamia, Polymerization and Reptilianne Vaskii. Venom Serpent is the only DARK monster among the Venom snakes, so it and Lamia are Fusion Material for Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons. Lamia drops their smaller monster to 0 ATK first (you take damage equal to that monster's original ATK, so aim it at the smaller one). The dragon's summon effect then drops their boss to 0 ATK and negates it. Reptilianne Vaskii Special Summons itself by Tributing both of their 0-ATK monsters: nothing is destroyed, so "can't be destroyed" doesn't save them. Their field is empty, and Four Heavenly Dragons (2800) and Vaskii (2600) attack for 5400. If they had a third face-up monster, Vaskii can destroy it once per turn. Extra Deck: Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons. Four summons, so Nibiru isn't live. Effect Veiler or Infinite Impermanence on the dragon's summon effect leaves only one monster at 0 ATK, and Vaskii can't come down.

cards.name: Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons
Any boss monster your opponent controls
Any second monster your opponent controls

steps.text: Normal Summon Venom Serpent. This line is for going second.
Activate effect: Reptilianne Lamia in your hand. Every monster you control is a face-up Reptile, so target your opponent's second monster.
Lamia resolves: your opponent's second monster's ATK becomes 0, and you Special Summon Reptilianne Lamia from your hand. Then you take damage equal to that monster's original ATK.
Activate Polymerization from your hand.
Send Venom Serpent from your field to the GY as material.
Send Reptilianne Lamia from your field to the GY as material.
Fusion Summon Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons (2 DARK monsters on the field).
Polymerization goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons was Special Summoned, targeting your opponent's boss: its ATK becomes 0, its effects are negated, and it becomes DARK.
Tribute your opponent's boss for Reptilianne Vaskii's summon. Its ATK is 0.
Tribute your opponent's second monster for Reptilianne Vaskii's summon. Its ATK is 0 too.
Special Summon Reptilianne Vaskii from your hand (by Tributing 2 face-up monsters with 0 ATK from anywhere on the field).

combo2.title: The Wing Dragon Route: Turn Your Own Clear Wing DARK, Then Fuse on Their Turn
combo2.description: Going first from Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio + Predaplant Byblisp. Predaplant Bal Teah (Longinephila + Ophrys Scorpio) brings back Ambulomelides, Bal Teah and Lilizard make Clear Wing Synchro Dragon, and Polymerization fuses Darlingtonia Cobra and Ambulomelides into Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons. Its summon effect targets your own Clear Wing, which stays DARK (and negated, at 0 ATK) for as long as it's face-up. Your board: Four Heavenly Dragons and the DARK Clear Wing, Predaplanning and Predaprime Fusion Set, and Bal Teah and Polymerization in the GY. On your opponent's turn, the first card or effect they activate lets the dragon fuse itself with Clear Wing into Starving Venom Wing Dragon. Their card still resolves: the dragon doesn't negate. It's a trade: Clear Wing's own negates are gone once it turns DARK. Skip that target and Bal Teah's GY effect can still fuse the two into Wing Dragon, but only when they Special Summon. If the dragon is negated before it can fuse, Predaprime Fusion can make Wing Dragon from the same two monsters (that part isn't in the checked line). Costs 1000 LP for Instant Fusion (Limited). Ash Blossom can hit any of the five adds, or Scorpio's and Ambulomelides's summons from the Deck. Nibiru is live after Longinephila, your fifth summon.

cards.name: Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons
Any card or effect your opponent activates

steps.text: Normal Summon Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio.
Activate effect: Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio was Normal Summoned. Its cost is a monster from your hand.
Send Predaplant Byblisp from your hand to the GY to pay Scorpio's cost.
Scorpio resolves: Special Summon Predaplant Darlingtonia Cobra from your Deck.
Activate effect: Predaplant Byblisp was sent to the GY (Chain Link 1).
Activate effect: Predaplant Darlingtonia Cobra was Special Summoned by a "Predaplant" effect (Chain Link 2). This one is once per Duel.
Cobra resolves: add Instant Fusion from your Deck to your hand. It's a "Fusion" Spell.
Byblisp resolves: add Predaplant Lilizard from your Deck to your hand.
Activate effect: Predaplant Lilizard in your hand. You control a "Predaplant" monster, so it can summon itself.
Special Summon Predaplant Lilizard from your hand.
Lilizard resolves: add Polymerization from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Instant Fusion from your hand and pay 1000 LP.
Fusion Summon Predaplant Ambulomelides from your Extra Deck. Instant Fusion's summon counts as a Fusion Summon, so Ambulomelides's search works.
Instant Fusion goes to the GY.
Activate effect: Predaplant Ambulomelides was just summoned.
Ambulomelides resolves: add Predaprime Fusion from your Deck to your hand. It's a "Predap" Spell.
Activate effect: Predaplant Ambulomelides, targeting itself.
Tribute Predaplant Ambulomelides.
Ambulomelides resolves: Special Summon Predaplant Longinephila from your Deck.
Activate effect: Predaplant Longinephila was Special Summoned.
Longinephila resolves: add Predaplanning from your Deck to your hand.
Send Predaplant Longinephila to the GY as Synchro Material.
Send Predaplant Ophrys Scorpio to the GY as Synchro Material.
Synchro Summon Predaplant Bal Teah (Level 4: 1 Tuner + 1 non-Tuner).
Activate effect: Predaplant Bal Teah was Synchro Summoned. It Special Summons 1 "Predaplant" or "Starving Venom" monster from your GY or face-up Extra Deck.
Special Summon Predaplant Ambulomelides from your GY. Instant Fusion summoned it properly, so it can come back.
Send Predaplant Bal Teah to the GY as Synchro Material.
Send Predaplant Lilizard to the GY as Synchro Material.
Synchro Summon Clear Wing Synchro Dragon (Level 7: Bal Teah is a Synchro Tuner).
Activate Polymerization from your hand.
Send Predaplant Darlingtonia Cobra from your field to the GY as material.
Send Predaplant Ambulomelides from your field to the GY as material.
Fusion Summon Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons (2 DARK monsters on the field).
Polymerization goes to the GY, next to Bal Teah.

Activate effect: Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons was Special Summoned, targeting your own Clear Wing Synchro Dragon: its ATK becomes 0, its effects are negated, and it becomes DARK for as long as it stays face-up.
Set Predaplanning.
Set Predaprime Fusion.
Your opponent's Main Phase: your opponent activates a card or effect.
Activate effect: Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons in response (Quick Effect). It Fusion Summons 1 DARK Fusion Monster using DARK monsters on either field, itself included.
Send Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons to the GY as material. It's the Fusion Monster.
Send Clear Wing Synchro Dragon to the GY as the second material. It's the "Clear Wing" monster, and it's DARK now.
Fusion Summon Starving Venom Wing Dragon (1 Fusion Monster + 1 "Clear Wing" monster).
